main_text.l: Ex molli liberorum apud matres edu-catione:
Ex anguinâ praeceptoribus fidelibus data mercede:
9. Fratrum & cognatorum odia Cainica: De fratri-bus & cog-natis.
main_text.head: CORONÆ MILITARIS
FLORES.
main_text.p: 1 Preces pia & Dei potentia in bellis omnia efficiunt. Hic recensentur Auxilii divini Modi varii: De belli auxilio divino,
2. Belli aequitas bono, iniquitas malo plerumq; litat eventui. Hic examinantur causâ & eventu.

page.notes: Printed "plerumq;" is read as shown; the abbreviation mark after q is uncertain. The "9." entry and the numbered entries 1 and 2 are kept as printed. Decorative ornament marks at the foot (")( )(") are omitted.
